additional_info.body:
Hello Markus,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0450669
for Black HMI on charger
MP/R7 170002226.
From your description, I understood that the HMI is off /dark), without back-lightning, that the 24V dc power supply reaches correctly the PCB board of the HMI, but that the LED of the board are off.
In this case, unfortunately the HMI is defective and needs to be replaced. Please proceed to order the correct spare part and replace the HMI:

moving the case
